s1.syndrome_frame: Acute onset of joint pain and swelling following medical treatment for a gynecological condition
salient_findings: Diffuse swelling and tenderness to palpation of both knees
Elevated erythrocyte sedimentation rate and C-reactive protein level
key_facts: 6 weeks of amenorrhea
Right lower-quadrant abdominal pain
Vaginal bleeding
Empty uterine cavity on transvaginal ultrasonography
Gestational sac in the right adnexa without fetal cardiac activity
Initial serum β-hCG level of 585 mIU/mL
Decline in β-hCG level after methotrexate treatment
Pain and swelling in both knees after methotrexate treatment
Diffuse swelling and tenderness to palpation of both knees
Elevated white-cell count
Elevated erythrocyte sedimentation rate
Elevated C-reactive protein level
Joint ultrasonography revealed anterior soft-tissue swelling with a thickened synovium and fluid collections

shortlist.label: Methotrexate-induced rheumatologic reaction
shortlist.why_kept: Patient developed joint pain and swelling after methotrexate treatment

shortlist.label: Reactive arthritis
shortlist.why_kept: Patient presented with joint pain and swelling following a gynecological condition

shortlist.label: Septic arthritis
shortlist.why_kept: Patient had elevated white-cell count and C-reactive protein level, suggesting a possible infectious cause

shortlist.label: Rheumatoid arthritis
shortlist.why_kept: Patient had diffuse swelling and tenderness to palpation of both knees, consistent with an inflammatory arthritis

shortlist.label: Seronegative spondyloarthropathy
shortlist.why_kept: Patient's symptoms and laboratory results are consistent with a spondyloarthropathy, such as ankylosing spondylitis or psoriatic arthritis

raw.rationale: The patient developed knee pain and swelling shortly after receiving methotrexate, with laboratory tests showing elevated inflammatory markers and joint ultrasonography revealing soft-tissue swelling and fluid collections, consistent with a methotrexate-induced reaction.

rejected.label: Reactive arthritis
rejected.why: Lack of preceding gastrointestinal or genitourinary infection

rejected.label: Septic arthritis
rejected.why: Patient was afebrile and had no other signs of infection

rejected.label: Rheumatoid arthritis
rejected.why: Acute onset and lack of typical rheumatoid arthritis symptoms

rejected.label: Seronegative spondyloarthropathy
rejected.why: No evidence of axial skeletal involvement or other characteristic features
